thread:
elaine: Hey team — putting together a short customer-facing 'capacity handshake' script we can use during Dedicated onboarding. Goal: one-pager script that engineers and SEs can read in <2 mins and cover SLA, burst behavior, prewarm, and rollback comms. Draft below, please quick review.

sam: LGTM overall. Couple of asks: call out explicit latency SLOs per tier and where prewarm kicks in. Also add a line about how we surface degraded tokens to customers. :+1:

taylor: Nice. Suggest we add the exact contact and escalation path (oncall vs AM) and a short script for the SE during the kickoff call. Customers always ask about "what happens if we exceed burst".

elaine: Good points. Updated draft with bullets. Keeping it intentionally short. Sharing final script mock:

1) Intro: confirm reserved pool size, region, and expected peak qps.
2) SLOs: latency target (P95/P99) and token throughput floor for the committed pool.
3) Burst behaviour: brief description — soft-burst enabled for X minutes, best-effort beyond that, automatic routing to fallback model if sustained. Include example: "If sustained 5m above committed qps we will route to a compatible model that could increase tail latency by ~50ms."
4) Prewarm: prewarm triggers (scheduled ramp or predictive), expected time-to-warm, and how credits are consumed.
5) Rollback/fallback: who executes rollback, and the communication script: "We detected sustained load beyond agreed burst; we initiated model fallback and opened a ticket. We're restoring normal routing in X mins, will follow up with telemetry and token billing details."
6) Communication: who to notify (AM, oncall, SE) and a short post-mortem window (24-72h).
7) Acceptance: customer signs off that the fallback behaviour and billing model are acceptable for GA.

sam: This is crisp. Two technical clarifications: add a line for KV cache cold-start expectations and one about quantized model quality delta (if we fall back to smaller quantized variant).

elaine: Added both. For the SE script I propose: "If you see intermittent throttle or degraded latency we'll escalate to ops. Meanwhile, you may suggest temporary rate limiting on client side or switching to fewer tokens per call. We'll handle routing and keep you updated every 15 minutes until stable."

ops-bot: CHECKLIST CREATED: onboarding-handshake-template v1 -> https://console.internal/templates/onboarding-handshake v1.0

elaine: Next steps: 1) SEs to trial with two upcoming pilots (Acme & FinCo). 2) Eng & SRE to confirm exact trigger numbers for soft-burst windows and fallback routing latency delta by EOD Wed. 3) Create a short one-slide cheat sheet for SEs.

taylor: I'll run trigger experiments on staging tomorrow and post results in this thread. Will include tail-latency numbers and prewarm timing.

sam: If anyone wants, I can add a tiny state machine diagram for the fallback flow to the cheat sheet.

elaine: Perfect — thanks. If we have no objections I'll send this to the SE list and attach the cheat sheet draft on Thursday. :shipit:
